What is the minimum order quantity for custom jerseys?
There is no high minimum order. You can order a single jersey, a complete team set or a larger bulk quantity based on your requirement.
How much does a custom sports jersey cost?
Pricing depends on the jersey style, fabric, sleeve type, print coverage and quantity. Yoode custom jerseys start from Γé╣490, with team pricing available for larger orders.
Can you design my jersey if I donΓÇÖt have artwork?
Yes. Share your logo, team colours, a reference image or even a rough idea. Our design team can prepare a mockup for you to review before production.
What can I customise on my team jersey?┬á
You can customise team colours, logos, player names, numbers, sponsor logos, patterns and other design elements to create a jersey that represents your team.
Can every jersey have a different player name and number?
Yes. Individual player names and numbers can be added across the team order. Simply provide the final player list when confirming your customisation.
How long does it take to receive custom jerseys?
Turnaround depends on the design, quantity and production requirements. Production is scheduled after you review and approve the final jersey mockup.
Do you deliver custom jerseys anywhere?
Yes. Yoode delivers custom jersey orders across worldwide. Customers can also choose to collect their order from a Yoode Experience Centre where available.
